checkpoint_note: NC-008 four checkpoint files match referenced SHA-256; no checkpoint modified.

findings.acceptance: older versions immutable / append-only registry integrity
findings.expected: Reject historical row because stored chain_sha256 no longer equals chain(zero_digest, row_without_chain)
findings.impact: A modified old row is trusted; a new promotion can be chained to its stale digest. No history-chain validation on append.
findings.input: Copy operator_promotions.jsonl first row; change source to FORGED-HISTORICAL-ENTRY without recomputing chain_sha256; call process([DOUBLE ADD_XX HALT], [(0,0),(1,1),(65535,123)], existing=[tampered_row]) without writing any candidate file.

findings.acceptance: malformed inputs rejected with traceable failed cases
findings.expected: Explicit REJECTED audit decision, not crash and absent audit record
findings.impact: Untrusted malformed proposal can terminate promotion and avoid durable rejection trail.

findings.acceptance: malformed and unknown instruction tokens rejected
findings.impact: body_of stops at first HALT and never validates trailing source-program tokens; unknown token is silently accepted as a promoted operator.

finite_program_checks.scope: 65,536 8-bit pairs, ten corners, 65,536 deterministic sampled 16-bit pairs; symbolic executor only

limitations: Finite symbolic validation does not establish neural execution or new primitive invention.
The 16-bit sample is not exhaustive over all 2^32 input pairs.
The registry uses unauthenticated local hash chaining, not trusted signatures or external append-only storage.
F1/F2/F3 were run in memory and did not mutate the candidate or live registry.
proof_scope: Pinned Git manifest/source/evidence hashes, four NC-008 checkpoint bytes, 11 existing unit tests and four finite symbolic candidate checks reproduce. Additional fresh in-memory negative controls expose accepted modified history and malformed program fail-open/crash. This is not neural execution, unbounded proof or signed agent identity.
reproduction: From a scratch import of artifacts/NC-009/promote.py, mutate one existing in-memory row source without recomputing chain_sha256 and call process() with a valid distinct DOUBLE candidate; observe PROMOTED.
Call process() with program=None and program=42; observe uncaught TypeError.
Call process() with program=["ADD_X1","HALT","BAD_OPCODE"]; observe PROMOTED.
